title: FE-model range of segmental rotations under combined compression + moment (Dreischarf 2014 part 2)

quantity.name: intervertebral rotation (FE model predictions)
quantity.definition: segmental rotation predicted by 6 models (5 in flexion): median and min-max across models (dotted bar and individual bars, Fig 3). Extension plotted negative. NOT experimental data.

source.authors: Dreischarf M, Zander T, Shirazi-Adl A, Puttlitz CM, Adam CJ, Chen CS, Goel VK, Kiapour A, Kim YH, Labus KM, Little JP, Park WM, Wang YH, Wilke HJ, Rohlmann A, Schmidt H
source.sample: 6 FE models (5 for flexion); six of the eight L1-L5 FE models (Models 1,2,3,5,6,7; Model 6 missing in flexion)

protocol.summary: Combined loads (Table 3): flexion 1175 N compression + 7.5 Nm (Rohlmann 2009); extension 500 N + 7.5 Nm (Rohlmann 2009); lateral bending 700 N + 7.8 Nm (Dreischarf 2012); axial rotation 720 N + 5.5 Nm (Dreischarf 2011).
how_to_simulate: Apply compressive follower load + pure moment on L1 per load case (Table 3)
Report rotation of each segment L1-L2..L4-L5 relative to the unloaded state
protocol.notes: Range = min-max of individual model bars (digitised); median = dotted FE-median bar (agrees with the median of the digitised model values). Compare with in vivo test fe_model_comparison.dreischarf2014.L1L5_invivo_ivr_secondary. Figures in the QUT eprints author version are low-resolution embedded bitmaps (~550x420 px for a 4-panel figure); digitised by pixel analysis of the extracted image against gridlines.

extraction.uncertainty: flexion/LB +/-0.3 deg; extension +/-0.15 deg; AR +/-0.1 deg
extraction.check_notes: Model bar tops found by automated column scan; FE-median bar heights equal the median of the model bars in all 16 cases (within 0.1 deg).

pass_rule.rule: PASS = inside in vivo range AND inside model range; MARGINAL = one
